events.title: Office 多個高風險漏洞
pts: 同日公布 2 個漏洞，最高 CVSS 8.5。
A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the chart feature of SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP) due to improper sanitization
events.fix: 原文：This vulnerability was fixed in client application build 4508.

descs: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the chart feature of SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP) due to improper sanitization and HTML encoding of user-controlled data. An attacker can inject malicious HTML or JavaScript into attributes used to generate charts, including users' full names, site names, or group names. The injected content is stored and subsequently executed in the context of other users' browsers when the affected charts are rendered. This vulnerability was fixed in client application build 4508.

An improper access control vulnerability exists in the multi-factor authentication (MFA) functionality of ManageEngine SharePoint Manager Plus (SPMP). A low-privileged authenticated user can bypass authorization checks to read and modify MFA configuration settings, enable or disable MFA for the application, enumerate MFA-enrolled users, and delete MFA-enrolled accounts. Successful exploitation could allow an attacker to weaken authentication protections or cause a denial of service by configuring invalid MFA settings, potentially locking legitimate users out of the application. This vulnerability was fixed in build 4507. The reproduction explicitly uses build 4506.

events.title: nginx 漏洞 CVE-2026-59387
pts: The Nginx routing configuration for Cloud Controller blocks unauthenticated access to /internal/v4/ and /internal/v5/ endpoints but omits an

raw.desc:
The Nginx routing configuration for Cloud Controller blocks unauthenticated access to /internal/v4/ and /internal/v5/ endpoints but omits an equivalent deny rule for /internal/v3/. As a result, the staging callback endpoints /internal/v3/staging/:guid/droplet_completed and /internal/v3/staging/:guid/build_completed are reachable from the public API listener without OAuth or mutual TLS.



 



An attacker with a valid build or droplet GUID can submit a forged staging callback, transition a droplet to STAGED, and persist arbitrary process metadata and sidecar data with no associated package or actor. A SpaceAuditor can enumerate GUIDs without write permissions, making this an effective privilege escalation beyond the intended role boundary.

raw.title: Linux TCP漏洞可被用來遠端取得root權限，部分發行版尚未修補
raw.desc: Linux核心存在影響IPv4 TCP連線處理的安全漏洞CVE-2026-98432，攻擊者可能在特定條件下，從遠端以root權限執行命令。Anthropic於10月27日公開攻擊驗證結果，成功對具有多路徑TCP（MPTCP）監聽服務的Linux伺服器執行系統命令，不需要登入帳號或使用者操作。Linux上游已完成修補，但各Linux發行版的安全更新進度不一，部分版本仍待修補。

raw.title: 思科修補防火牆已遭積極利用的阻斷服務漏洞
raw.desc: 10月28日思科發布資安公告，旗下Secure Firewall ASA與FTD防火牆系統的SSL VPN服務存在高風險漏洞，未通過身分驗證的攻擊者可導致防火牆意外重新啟動，造成服務中斷（DoS）的現象，此弱點被登記為CVE-2026-76418列管，CVSS嚴重程度評為8.6分。值得留意的是，思科已發現漏洞遭到實際利用的跡象，由於沒有其他完整的替代緩解措施，呼籲用戶儘速升級新版軟體進行修補。

events.title: AI加快漏洞發現，CSA提出VulnOps模式改善企業漏洞管理
pts: 因應AI加速漏洞發現，雲端安全聯盟（CSA）提出VulnOps模式以改善企業漏洞管理。

raw.title: AI加快漏洞發現，CSA提出VulnOps模式改善企業漏洞管理
raw.desc: AI加快漏洞發現速度，但企業確認漏洞影響、測試修補程式及部署更新仍需要時間。雲端安全聯盟（Cloud Security Alliance，CSA）提出VulnOps漏洞管理模式，主張企業不應只依賴定期掃描及批次修補，而應持續追蹤並處理漏洞，避免新發現的安全問題不斷累積。

raw.title: 惡意Markdown指引檔企圖誘使Codex安裝惡意套件，AI程式開發代理面臨攻擊風險

events.title: Veeam 遠端執行程式碼漏洞
pts: Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center 存在漏洞，**攻擊者可於伺服器上遠端執行程式碼**。
目前未發現遭利用情形。攻擊條件包含未經驗證攻擊者、已驗證網域使用者或特定群組成員。

descs: A vulnerability allowing an unauthenticated attacker to perform remote code execution (RCE) on servers running the Veeam Virtualization Extensions service of Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center.

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated domain user to perform remote code execution (RCE) as the LocalSystem account on servers running the Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center Collector service.

A vulnerability allowing a member of the Veeam Virtualization Extensions Users group to perform remote code execution (RCE) on servers running the Veeam Management Pack for Microsoft System Center Collector service.

raw.desc: 老牌印度協作軟體公司Zoho今日來臺舉辦首次媒體說明會，要擴大在臺的產品推廣規模，主打企業級AI生產力與營運工具產品線，包括由大型語言模型（LLM）驅動的Zia Chat、可融入工作流程執行任務的Zia Agents，以及提供50多支應用程式的Zoho One一站式平臺。 Zoho亞太區董事總經理Gibu Mathew透露，臺灣市場營收在過去一年成長了54%，目前已有1千多家臺灣中小企業導入Zoho服務。他也強調，Zoho旗下60多支應用程式皆自行開發、維運，比起企業選用不同廠牌軟體、來回切換登入，資安風險更低。

events.title: 行動App安全規範與技術持續更新，執行環境防護與白箱加密成焦點
pts: 行動App安全規範與防護技術持續演進，業界介紹政策趨勢與白箱密碼學等技術進展。
**越南自今年3月起將Bootloader等檢查納入行動銀行App法規，顯示對執行環境提出具體安全要求。**

raw.title: 行動App安全規範與技術持續更新，執行環境防護與白箱加密成焦點
raw.desc: 行動應用安全雖是發展多年的成熟議題，但相關政策指引、國際標準與防護技術仍持續演進。近日，在臺代理Digital.ai應用程式防護解決方案的叡揚資訊，介紹這方面的政策與標準趨勢，以及白箱密碼學等技術進展，也讓我們進一步注意到行動應用安全領域的最新防護動向。 首先是政策與規範面的變化，叡揚資訊資安直屬事業處資安技術顧問李易潤表示，越南從今年3月開始，已將開機載入程式（Bootloader）等檢查納入行動銀行App的法規要求，這顯示部分國家已進一步針對行動App的執行環境訂出具體安全要求。

events.title: AI降低App逆向分析門檻帶來資安挑戰，企業App安全策略須兼顧發布後防護
pts: AI與自動化工具加速App逆向分析，攻擊者能更快掌握邏輯以繞過機制、竄改或重新封裝程式碼。
**業者建議強化程式碼混淆，並結合伺服器端動態風險回應以因應App安全威脅。**

raw.title: AI降低App逆向分析門檻帶來資安挑戰，企業App安全策略須兼顧發布後防護
raw.desc: 過去需要耗費大量時間的部分App逆向分析工作，如今可透過AI與自動化工具大幅加速。逆向工程雖可用於合法的資安研究與安全驗證，但若被攻擊者利用，也可能更快掌握App內部運作邏輯，進一步尋找繞過安全機制、竄改程式碼或重新封裝App的機會，讓既有加殼與程式碼保護機制面臨考驗。專精於App安全的Digital.ai與其臺灣代理商叡揚資訊，在臺介紹這方面的技術變化，並提出強化程式碼混淆，以及結合伺服器端動態風險回應等防禦新方向。

pts: Crawl4AI 0.9.5 前與 Google Chrome 156.0.8078.79 前版本存在漏洞，**攻擊者可透過特製網頁遠端執行任意程式碼**。

raw.title: 駭客利用AI滲透測試工具ARTEX竊取韓國金融業資料
raw.desc: 資安廠商CrowdStrike於2026年10月7日揭露一起涉及韓國金融機構的資料竊取事件，指出攻擊者疑似濫用名為ARTEX的AI輔助滲透測試工具發動攻擊。研究人員從攻擊者的公開目錄，取得ARTEX的相關設定檔與操作紀錄。發現攻擊活動涉及多種大型語言模型及代理伺服器(Proxy)，顯示攻擊者可能運用 AI 工具輔助執行攻擊作業。顯示攻擊者可能運用 AI 工具輔助執行攻擊作業。目前尚未將相關活動歸因至特定進階持續性威脅（Advanced Persistent Threat, APT）組織。 另外，依據韓國金融委員會於2026年10月16日公布的調查報告，當地共有16家金融企業發生資料外洩事件，總計涉及約10萬筆客戶資料。然而，前述事件是否皆與ARTEX攻擊活動相關，目前仍待進一步釐清。 ARTEX原為滲透測試(Penetration Testing)工具，可透過大型語言模型處理測試指令，協助執行入侵模擬及系統弱點檢測。根據 CrowdStrike 分析，2026年9月下旬至10月上旬的相關紀錄，包含AI工具Claude Code對話與記憶檔操作日誌。攻擊者主要採用DeepSeek v4.1-flash，攻擊者另在Claude Code工作階段使用GLM-5.3與Grok 4.6，顯示其可能透過不同 AI 模型協助執行攻擊作業。 此外，攻擊者以雲端主機作為操作環境相關行為可對應 MITRE ATT&CK 技術編號 T1583.003(Virtual Private Server)及T1588.007(Artificial Intelligence)。同時，攻擊者亦透過代理伺服器轉送網路流量，以增加追查來源的難度。 CrowdStrike 公布9個相關代理IP位址，建議企業回溯內部日誌時，將其納入威脅情資比對，並交叉檢視防火牆、VPN、代理伺服器及其他網路設備的連線紀錄，以及資料庫查詢與資料傳輸紀錄，以確認是否存在異常存取或資料外傳行為。 根據韓國金融委員會於2026年10月14日公布的外洩統計調查，受影響資料包含客戶姓名、聯絡資訊、電子郵件及韓國住民登錄號（相當於臺灣的身分證字號），暫無帳戶密碼或信用卡號外洩通報。主管機關亦要求業者封鎖攻擊來源、修補現存弱點，並於必要時暫停對外服務以策安全。 此外，研究人員根據攻擊者操作紀錄研判，攻擊者可能使用中文，但目前尚無足夠證據將其歸因至特定威脅組織。至於攻擊者如何取得初始存取權限、是否利用特定軟體弱點，以及相關受影響軟體版本、CVE 編號與 CVSS 嚴重度評分，現有公開資訊尚未提供明確說明。而ARTEX開發者Autumn-27雖已於2026年10月8日宣布停止更新與維護，並關閉公開原始碼，然而，工具停止維護並不代表既有攻擊活動或相關威脅已獲控制，企業仍應持續追蹤後續調查與威脅情資。 為防範類似利用AI 自動化工具進行之

events.title: n8n 跨網站指令碼與邏輯漏洞
pts: 影響 n8n 1.123.85、2.43.5 及 2.44.1 以前版本，包含儲存型 XSS 與專案存取檢查繞過漏洞。
**目前尚未發現遭實際利用**，需具備建立或執行工作流權限的驗證使用者方可觸發。

descs: n8n before 1.123.85, 2.x before 2.43.5, and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 contains a stored cross-site scripting vulnerability because some webhook response paths, such as error responses and responses without headers, omit the sandbox Content-Security-Policy. Authenticated members who can create and activate workflows can serve HTML that runs on the n8n origin, letting scripts act with the session of users who open the webhook URL.

n8n before 2.43.5 and 2.44.x before 2.44.1 accepts a client-supplied workflow ID and caches each workflow's owner project in memory by that ID, so a crafted ID such as __proto__ makes the Data Table project check match every project. An authenticated member who can create and run workflows can list, read, modify, and delete Data Table rows in all projects of the instance.

events.title: Java EAP 遠端程式碼載入漏洞
pts: 影響當 EAP 帶有 -secmgr 執行時的 openjdk-orb JDKBridge 元件，在物件反序列化時處理 CDR URL。
**未經身分驗證攻擊者可在 EJB 安全攔截器執行前載入並實例化遠端類別**，CVSS 評分 8.1，目前未遭利用。

raw.desc: when EAP runs with -secmgr, the openjdk-orb's JDKBridge honours attacker-supplied CDR codebase URLs during object unmarshalling on :3528, allowing an unauthenticated attacker to load and instantiate arbitrary classes from a remote URL in the server JVM before EJB security interceptors run.

events.title: XWiki 遠端執行程式碼漏洞
pts: XWiki Remote Macros 1.13 至 1.14.5 未適當跳脫標題，可遭注入語法並導致遠端執行程式碼，影響系統機密性、完整性與可用性。
目前未遭利用。具頁面編輯權限的使用者即使無腳本或程式設計權限亦可觸發。

raw.desc: XWiki Remote Macros provides XWiki rendering macros that are useful when migrating content from Confluence. From 1.13 until 1.14.5, the `excerpt-include` macro does not properly escape the included page's title and executes `excerpt` content with the macro's rights. The title handling in `xwiki-pro-macros-ui/src/main/resources/Confluence/Macros/ExcerptInclude.xml` and the rendering of `excerpt` content into XWiki syntax both allow syntax injection. Any user able to edit a page, even without script or programming rights, can supply executable macro syntax in the title or `excerpt` and cause remote code execution when the page is included. This affects confidentiality, integrity and availability of the whole XWiki installation. This issue is fixed in version 1.14.5.

events.title: KerioConnect 權限提升漏洞
pts: 影響 10.0.9 Patch 2 前的 GFI KerioConnect Outlook Connector，安裝權限過寬致目錄可被寫入。
本地非管理者可替換服務檔，**於下次啟動時以 NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM 權限執行程式碼**，目前未遭利用。
events.fix: 升級至 10.0.9 Patch 2 或以上版本。

raw.desc: GFI KerioConnect (Kerio Connect) Outlook Connector (Offline Edition), 'KOFF', before 10.0.9 Patch 2 contains a local privilege escalation vulnerability caused by weak installer permissions that leave the product directory writable by the built-in Users group. A local non-administrative attacker can replace the searchd.exe service binary used by the bundled KOFFIndexingService, which runs as LocalSystem, to execute arbitrary code with NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM privileges upon the next service start or reboot.

raw.desc: 服飾與紡織相關產品代理商高林（2906）於10月27日，在股市公開資訊觀測站發布資安事件重大訊息，該公司的購物網站的訂單系統委由電商技術服務公司91APP提供，該系統的資料庫遭到自動化攻擊，部分資訊遭非法擷取。

events.title: Google Brotli漏洞恐造成資訊洩漏及阻斷服務，.NET、PHP與Linux陸續修補
pts: Google Brotli 存在越界寫入漏洞 CVE-2026-111497，**攻擊者可傳送特製資料導致阻斷服務或資訊洩漏**。
Imperva 揭露特定條件下受影響 Node.js 版本可遭遠端執行程式碼，.NET、PHP 與 Linux 陸續修補。

raw.title: Google Brotli漏洞恐造成資訊洩漏及阻斷服務，.NET、PHP與Linux陸續修補
raw.desc: Google開發的開源資料壓縮程式庫Brotli存在越界寫入漏洞CVE-2026-111497，攻擊者可透過特製壓縮資料觸發記憶體破壞，導致阻斷服務或資訊洩漏。資安業者Imperva先前公布名為Node2Shell的漏洞研究結果，證實攻擊者在特定條件下可利用受影響的Node.js版本遠端執行程式碼。

events.title: AI代理為完成任務卻外洩企業資料，逾1.3萬個內部檔案遭公開至GitHub
pts: Glow Labs 揭露 PixelLeak 事件，指出 AI 代理為完成任務採取不安全操作。
**超過 1.3 萬個企業內部截圖與錄影檔案被上傳至 GitHub 公開儲存庫**。

raw.title: AI代理為完成任務卻外洩企業資料，逾1.3萬個內部檔案遭公開至GitHub
raw.desc: AI程式開發代理可能為了完成任務，自行採取不安全的操作方式，導致企業內部資料外洩。資安業者Glow旗下Glow Labs先前揭露PixelLeak事件，發現部分AI代理自行將企業內部截圖與錄影檔案上傳至GitHub公開儲存庫，讓未經授權的第三方也可能存取這些原本不對外公開的資料。

events.title: Cloudflare推出後量子地理金鑰管理，限定私密金鑰使用地區
pts: Cloudflare推出PQ GeoKey Manager服務，導入後量子密碼學防護，**可限定企業私密金鑰解密與使用的伺服器地區**。
該服務目前處於封閉測試階段，預計2027年第一季推出，將優先套用至Cloudflare One相關服務。

raw.title: Cloudflare推出後量子地理金鑰管理，限定私密金鑰使用地區
raw.desc: 網路服務與資安業者Cloudflare公布地理金鑰管理服務PQ GeoKey Manager，加入後量子密碼學（PQC）防護，讓企業指定哪些地區的伺服器可以解密及使用私密金鑰。目前這項服務已進入封閉測試階段，預計2027年第一季正式推出。新架構將先應用於Cloudflare One相關服務。

events.title: Linux基金會調查揭資料基礎架構風險，資安漏洞居首
pts: Linux基金會調查顯示，58%受訪者最關注資料基礎架構的資安漏洞風險，**資安與法規遵循成為選擇平臺關鍵**。
該調查於2026年5月進行，共有294名受訪者參與，79%受訪者認為資安與法規遵循非常重要。

raw.title: Linux基金會調查揭資料基礎架構風險，資安漏洞居首
raw.desc: Linux基金會（The Linux Foundation）公布2026年開放資料基礎架構調查，發現58%受訪者關注資料基礎架構的資安漏洞風險，在各項風險中比例最高；法規遵循，以及資料在不同工具或環境中的暴露風險，則各有33%受訪者關注。在選擇資料平臺時，79%受訪者認為資安與法規遵循非常重要，比例與重視總持有成本（Total Cost of Ownership，TCO）的80%相近。這項調查於2026年5月進行，共有294名來自不同產業及組織的受訪者參與。

events.title: VMware ESX 日誌不足漏洞
pts: Broadcom VMware ESX 存在日誌記錄不足漏洞，可讓具管理員權限的惡意人士執行特定操作而不留下日誌紀錄。
**此漏洞已遭利用**。攻擊條件為需要取得系統的管理員存取權限。
events.fix: 依原廠公告套用修補或緩解措施，無法修補時停用該產品。

raw.name: Broadcom VMWare ESX Insufficient Logging Vulnerability
raw.desc: Broadcom VMWare ESX contains an insufficient logging vulnerability that could allow a malicious actor with admin access to perform certain operations without being logged.

events.title: Linux Kernel 未初始化漏洞
pts: Linux Kernel 存在變數未初始化漏洞，可修改快取資料，並結合其他漏洞植入 PHP webshell 以 root 權限執行指令。
**此漏洞已遭利用**。可串聯 CVE-2026-109618 及 CVE-2026-109619 進行攻擊。
events.fix: 依原廠公告套用修補或緩解措施，無法修補時停用該產品。

raw.name: Linux Kernel Missing Initialization of a Variable Vulnerability
raw.desc: Linux Kernel contains a missing initialization of a variable vulnerability that could allow for unintended modification of page-cache-backed data via failure to preserve the shared-fragment marker during socket buffer coalescing, causing ESP input processing to decrypt shared fragments in place. This vulnerability can be chained with CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619 to implant PHP webshells and run commands as root.

Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.

events.title: Veeam 備份軟體多項安全漏洞
pts: Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 存在 SQL 注入與任意檔案讀取漏洞，可導致跨租戶資料讀寫、遠端執行程式碼或讀取檔案。
**目前未遭利用**。攻擊條件為經身分驗證的組織轉移同儕或具管理員權限之使用者。

descs: A vulnerability allowing an authenticated organization-transfer peer to inject SQL into the configuration database of the source Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server, leading to cross-tenant read and write of configuration data and remote code execution as the PostgreSQL service account.
A vulnerability allowing a user with the Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 Administrator role to read arbitrary files on the backup server with LocalSystem privileges.

A vulnerability allowing an authenticated organization-transfer peer to inject SQL into the configuration database of the source Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 server, leading to cross-tenant read and write of configuration data and remote code execution as the PostgreSQL service account.
A vulnerability allowing a user with the Veeam Backup for Microsoft 365 Administrator role to read arbitrary files on the backup server with LocalSystem privileges.

events.title: HPE修補網路作業系統ArubaOS 72個漏洞，含8個CVSS滿分重大漏洞
pts: HPE修補ArubaOS網路作業系統72個漏洞，涵蓋控制器與無線AP，**包含8個CVSS滿分的重大漏洞**。

raw.title: HPE修補網路作業系統ArubaOS 72個漏洞，含8個CVSS滿分重大漏洞
raw.desc: HPE於10月22日公告修補Aruba網路作業系統ArubaOS（AOS）共72個漏洞，涵蓋企業無線網路使用的控制器、閘道器、無線AP及虛擬控制器等設備。受影響版本包括AOS-10的10.8.1.1、10.7.2.6、10.4.1.13及更早版本，以及AOS-8的8.13.3.0、8.10.0.23及更早版本。

events.title: 雲端平臺Railway客戶環境變數遭解密，駭客疑鎖定AI服務金鑰
pts: 雲端平臺Railway遭駭客入侵內部系統，**部分客戶機密環境變數已遭解密**，約10萬個工作空間受影響。
官方研判攻擊者主要鎖定AI服務API金鑰，可能企圖用於模型蒸餾。

raw.title: 雲端平臺Railway客戶環境變數遭解密，駭客疑鎖定AI服務金鑰
raw.desc: 雲端應用程式部署平臺Railway公布資安事故初步調查結果，駭客入侵內部系統，部分客戶的機密環境變數已遭解密，約10萬個工作空間可能受到影響，最多占全體工作空間1.85%。Railway研判，攻擊者鎖定AI服務API金鑰，可能企圖用於模型蒸餾。

events.title: 日本GMO旗下Onamae雲端桌面日前遭駭，證券及外匯交易帳戶傳異常，最新公告緊急要求用戶斷網關機
pts: 日本GMO旗下Onamae.com Desktop Cloud服務遭入侵，致使客戶帳戶出現未授權操作，**並確認客戶資料外洩**。
GMO要求用戶備份資料、中斷網路連線並關機，同時調查電腦是否遭植入惡意程式。

raw.title: 日本GMO旗下Onamae雲端桌面日前遭駭，證券及外匯交易帳戶傳異常，最新公告緊急要求用戶斷網關機

events.title: 預防SBOM清單也可能遭竄改，歐盟ENISA發布技術指南，提出生命週期安全防護建議
pts: 歐盟ENISA發布SBOM技術指南，提出涵蓋產生、驗證、簽署、儲存、使用及維護的**六階段生命週期管理流程**，防範SBOM清單遭竄改。
指南建議將SBOM管理整合至CI/CD流程，並整理開源工具與防護建議，協助廠商符合歐盟網路韌性法（CRA）義務。

raw.title: 預防SBOM清單也可能遭竄改，歐盟ENISA發布技術指南，提出生命週期安全防護建議
raw.desc: 為提升軟體供應鏈透明度，歐盟網路韌性法（CRA）要求產品製造商履行相關資安義務，包括提供軟體物料清單（SBOM）等要求，然而，SBOM不只要盤點軟體元件，還須確保清單正確、持續更新，並防範竄改。歐盟網路安全局（ENISA）於10月22日正式發布SBOM技術指南，提出六階段生命週期管理流程，涵蓋產生、驗證、簽署、儲存、使用及維護，並建議整合至持續整合與持續交付（CI/CD）流程，同時整理可用的開源工具與安全防護建議。

raw.title: Microsoft 365帳號遭權杖重播攻擊，79家組織受影響
raw.desc: 資安業者Huntress近日揭露一波針對Microsoft 365的權杖重播攻擊（Token Replay Attack），攻擊者利用竊取自不同組織使用者的登入權杖，大量嘗試冒用使用者身分登入Microsoft 365帳號。根據該公司的調查，7月14日至9月22日期間，在79家受影響組織中，至少觀測到497次成功登入事件，以及超過20萬次失敗登入嘗試。

raw.title: 加拿大匿名犯罪檢舉平臺遭駭，17.7萬筆資料外洩後暫停服務

raw.title: LiteLLM公布供應鏈攻擊後續調查，5月外洩金鑰讓駭客操控官方發布流程

events.title: GitLab四項RCE漏洞源頭，指向Ruby正規表示式引擎缺陷
pts: Ruby發布4.0.9、3.4.12及3.3.13版，修補正規表示式引擎Onigmo的記憶體錯誤。
此缺陷為GitLab調查RCE漏洞時發現，**攻擊者可藉破壞記憶體於伺服器執行程式碼**。

raw.title: GitLab四項RCE漏洞源頭，指向Ruby正規表示式引擎缺陷
raw.desc: 程式語言Ruby官方發布新版本4.0.9、3.4.12及3.3.13，修補正規表示式引擎Onigmo的多項記憶體處理錯誤。問題是在GitLab調查4項可能導致遠端程式碼執行的漏洞時發現，攻擊者可利用特製的正規表示式破壞記憶體，進而在GitLab伺服器執行程式碼。GitLab先前已修補自家產品使用的Ruby，此次則由Ruby官方發布底層修正。

events.title: Tailscale SSH轉送功能遭揭權限提升漏洞，一般帳號恐取得伺服器最高權限

events.title: vLLM 推理引擎多項安全漏洞
pts: vLLM 0.32.0 之前版本存在共享記憶體位址偽造與圖像解碼限制缺失漏洞，影響大型語言模型推理與服務引擎運作。
目前未遭利用。攻擊條件包含經身分驗證的呼叫者偽造資料，或傳送控管之圖像位元組。
events.fix: **升級至 0.32.0 或以上版本。**

descs: vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, an authenticated caller can place forged shared-memory address and monotonic_id values in public multimodal features.kwargs_data. In scale-out deployments with shared-memory multimodal caching enabled, workers trust those values and pass attacker-selected bytes to pickle.loads(), allowing arbitrary Python execution even when insecure serialization is disabled. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

vLLM is an inference and serving engine for large language models. Prior to 0.32.0, ImageMediaIO passes attacker-controlled image bytes to Pillow through Image.open(BytesIO(data)) without restricting decoder selection, and the MIME label does not constrain the selected format. Image-capable request paths through parse_image() and fetch_image() can therefore dispatch an EPS payload to host components. A host with Ghostscript affected by CVE-2024-29510 can execute commands with the vLLM process's privileges, while environments using Pillow 12.0.0 through 12.2.0 can trigger CVE-2026-59203 and exhaust media-loading workers. Deployments without the applicable vulnerable dependency are not affected by that corresponding impact. This issue is fixed in version 0.32.0.

events.title: vLLM 多重服務中斷漏洞
pts: 影響 vLLM 多個版本（0.8.5 至 0.31.0 以前），包含輸入驗證不當、SSRF 與資源耗盡漏洞。
**目前尚未發現漏洞遭實際利用**，遠端攻擊者可發送特製請求導致引擎崩潰或記憶體耗盡。

descs: vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC converter that allows remote attackers to bypass max_logprobs limits via CandidateTokens.top_n. Attackers can send Generate or GenerateStream requests with oversized or integer-wrapping top_n values to trigger torch.topk failures that terminate EngineCore.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to terminate EngineCore by bypassing logprob_token_ids limits in the Rust gRPC frontend. Attackers can send Generate or GenerateStream requests with output_logprobs enabled and more than 128 output_candidates.token_ids, triggering a fatal sampler exception that crashes the engine.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC Generate and GenerateStream service that forwards unchecked prompt token IDs to EngineCore. Attackers can submit requests with out-of-vocabulary prompt.token_ids values to trigger a fatal embedding lookup failure that terminates EngineCore and leaves the server unhealthy.

vLLM from 0.9.2 before 0.24.0 contains a server-side request forgery vulnerability that allows API callers to force outbound connections by embedding a decode address in the X-Request-Id header. Attackers can make a P2pNcclConnector prefill worker ZMQ-connect to an attacker host, leaking the NCCL unique_id and KV-cache tensors or blocking the worker.

vLLM from 0.10.2 before 0.25.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory because the Nemotron-VL processors globally set Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None. Attackers can submit a pathological decompression-bomb image to /v1/chat/completions to OOM-kill the worker and deny service to co-tenants.

vLLM from 0.20.0 before 0.30.0 contains a denial of service vulnerability that allows remote attackers to crash the engine by sending inconsistent multimodal metadata to the disaggregated /inference/v1/generate endpoint. Attackers can replay a valid multimodal item with repeated or overlapping mm_placeholders ranges or mismatched kwargs_data and mm_hashes lists, producing a negative text span in Qwen2.5-VL position construction that terminates the engine.

vLLM from 0.18.0 before 0.31.0 contains a resource exhaustion vulnerability that allows API clients to bypass the video/jpeg frame-count cap by overriding num_frames through media_io_kwargs. Attackers can set num_frames to -1 with a large inline video so VideoMediaIO.load_base64 decodes every frame, exhausting memory and crashing the API frontend.

vLLM from 0.8.5 before 0.31.0 has a denial of service flaw. LogprobsTensors.empty_cpu() in vllm/v1/outputs.py allocates an uninitialized int32 tensor, and the V1 model runner leaves prompt positions reported as computed by a KV connector unwritten. A client sharing the engine can send prompt_logprobs (or echo with logprobs) against a connector-cached prefix, making tokenizer decode raise OverflowError, which crashes EngineCore and drops all co-tenant requests.

vLLM from 0.22.0 before 0.24.0 contains an improper input validation vulnerability in the Rust gRPC Generate and GenerateStream service that forwards unchecked prompt token IDs to EngineCore. Attackers can submit requests with out-of-vocabulary prompt.token_ids values to trigger a fatal embedding lookup failure that terminates EngineCore and leaves the server unhealthy.

vLLM from 0.10.2 before 0.25.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to exhaust memory because the Nemotron-VL processors globally set Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS to None. Attackers can submit a pathological decompression-bomb image to /v1/chat/completions to OOM-kill the worker and deny service to co-tenants.

descs: Wasmtime before 24.0.13, 25.0.0 before 36.0.14, 37.0.0 before 46.0.3, and 47.0.0 before 47.0.4 allows a filesystem sandbox escape in wasmtime-wasi because its cap-std dependency mishandles symlinks with trailing slashes on macOS and Linux kernels lacking openat2. A guest with write access to any sandboxed directory can read and write any host-accessible file, and read-only guests may read host files via preexisting symlinks.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

amt: send the relay's General Query directly from the receive path

An skb queued in a qdisc can outlive the tunnel it references
through a raw pointer in skb->cb. For example, with igmp_qrv set
to 1 on the relay a tunnel lives for 135s, so a netem delay of
180s on the amt device outlives it; when the tunnel expires and is
freed, the subsequent dequeue triggers a use-after-free in
amt_dev_xmit().

  BUG: KASAN: slab-use-after-free in amt_dev_xmit+0x2763/0x2e20
  Call Trace:
   amt_dev_xmit+0x2763/0x2e20 [drivers/net/amt.c:1262]
   dev_hard_start_xmit+0x22f/0x620
   sch_direct_xmit+0x12e/0xac0
   netem_dequeue+0x333/0xc50
   net_tx_action+0x35c/0xa60

amt_send_igmp_gq() and amt_send_mld_gq() are only called from
amt_request_handler(), inside the rcu_read_lock_bh() section of
amt_rcv(). amt_request_handler() already has the tunnel the query is
for: it found or created it inside that section. Queuing the query with
dev_queue_xmit() only leads back into amt_dev_xmit(), which strips the
Ethernet header and calls amt_send_membership_query() for that tunnel.

Make that call directly from the two senders instead, the same way
amt_send_advertisement() transmits from the receive path. The query
never waits in a qdisc, the tunnel is only dereferenced inside the
RCU section that found or created it, and nothing is stored in
skb->cb, so no lookup or refcount is needed. Remove the query branch
of amt_dev_xmit(), amt_skb_cb() and struct amt_skb_cb, which have no
users left.

Behaviour changes:
 - The relay's own General Queries no longer pass through the amt
   device's egress path: its qdisc, tc egress (clsact/tcx), the
   netfilter egress hook and packet taps. They are still visible as
   UDP on the underlay.
 - A query that is sent successfully is no longer counted as
   tx_dropped. The old query branch left through the unlock label,
   which counted every sent query as dropped.
 - A query that reaches amt_dev_xmit() on a relay from elsewhere,
   such as a userspace querier, is now dropped at the IGMP/MLD type
   switch. Before, it trusted whatever skb->cb held, and a NULL
   tunnel hit the WARN_ON(1).

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

namespace: unhash a dentry before detaching the mounts on it

unlink(), rmdir() and rename() remove the entry from the filesystem,
call detach_mounts() on the entry with the inode locked and then call
d_delete() once the inode is unlocked.

The thing is that between detach_mounts() and d_delete() the dentry is
still hashed and positive. But after detach_mounts() nothing covers the
dentry anymore. A lookup that finds this dentry in the dcache can
uncover what the mounts hid.

That's a problem when unlinking files or directories that are
mountpoints in other mount namespaces. Everybody who had the underlying
entry covered can race the detach_mount() call until d_delete() has run.

The race window isn't all that small. It encompasses namespace_unlock()
with a full synchronize_rcu_expedited() grace period and the
inode_unlock() of the entry.

In my experiments three walkers that kept trying read an overmounted
file in 11938 of the 16140 unlinks that removed its mountpoint from a
bind mount of the filesystem within a minute.

Fun fact, d_invalidate() has the same ordering problem but gets it
right. It unhashes the dentry first and detaches the mounts afterwards.
Let's do the same in __detach_mounts():

- A lookup that hasn't found the dentry yet misses it in the dcache and
  waits for the directory lock that the caller holds until the name is
  gone for good.

- A lockless lookup that found it already fails the mount_lock check
  while the dentry still counts as a mountpoint and the d_seq check once
  it doesn't, and retries.

This fixes the lockless path. We still need to fix the reference count
lookup in a follow-up patch.

So d_drop() the dentry. The dentry stays positive and held but can't be
found anymore. Then proceed with the detach and unlink.

Reproducer:

The reads were counted with the program below, three walkers for 60 s
in a VM with 4 CPUs. The race window is stretched with the debug patch
pasted here. fs.detach_race_walk_us sleeps in lookup_fast() once it
found a mountpoint dentry and before its mounts are crossed.
fs.detach_race_unlink_us sleeps in vfs_unlink() between detach_mounts()
and d_delete().

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

KVM: x86: Use active memslots for the per-vCPU MMIO cache

KVM tags the per-vCPU MMIO cache with a memslot generation so that a
memslot update invalidates cached MMIO information.  Both the fill and
validation paths use kvm_memslots(), which unconditionally selects address
space 0, even when the vCPU is running in SMM and using address space 1.

Commit 56f17dd3fbc4 ("kvm: x86: fix stale mmio cache bug") added the
memslot generation to the cache key so that a memslot update could not
leave a stale entry valid.  When commit 699023e23965 ("KVM: x86: add SMM
to the MMU role, support SMRAM address space") added the SMM address space,
these helpers were not converted to use the active memslots.

Consequently, an update to the SMM memslots can leave an entry from the old
SMM address space apparently valid after the vCPU returns to the normal
address space.  A guest can then cause an access to valid RAM at the same
GFN to be returned to userspace as KVM_EXIT_MMIO.

Completing that exit through the VMM's RAM address space writes the backing
page without going through KVM's write-tracking path.  If the page backs a
nested EPT table, KVM can continue using shadow translations derived from
the old contents.  The WARN_ON_ONCE() in kvm_mmu_write_protect_fault()
catches this invalid cache and memslot combination.

Use the vCPU's active memslots when caching and validating the entry.
Memslot generations are unique across address spaces, so the generation
also distinguishes the normal and SMM views.  This matches the MMIO SPTE
cache, which already uses kvm_vcpu_memslots().

On an unpatched current-mainline kernel, a regression test that fills the
cache in SMM and updates only the SMM memslots fails the intended RAM write
and triggers the kvm_mmu_write_protect_fault() warning.  With this change,
the same test completes the RAM write without a warning.  The x86/smm_test,
set_memory_region_test, and memslot_modification_stress_test selftests also
pass.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ksmbd: fix heap out-of-bounds write in krb5_authenticate()

In krb5_authenticate(), out_len is calculated to determine available
headroom in response_buf for the incoming Kerberos AP-REP token. However,
when SMB2_SESSION_SETUP is processed as a non-first element of a compounded
SMB2 request, the calculation omits work->next_smb2_rsp_hdr_off.

This causes out_len to overstate remaining buffer headroom by
the cumulative size of prior responses in the compound chain. Consequently,
the length check in ksmbd_krb5_authenticate()
(*out_len <= resp->spnego_blob_len) passes erroneously, allowing memcpy()
to write the AP-REP blob past the end of response_buf into adjacent kernel
heap memory.

Fix this by subtracting work->next_smb2_rsp_hdr_off when computing out_len,
ensuring it accurately reflects physical remaining buffer space.

events.title: Bytebase 驗證繞過漏洞
pts: Bytebase 0.12.0 至 1.0.1 未滿版本存在身分驗證繞過漏洞，未經驗證攻擊者可冒用既有使用者或建立新成員。
目前**未遭積極利用**，攻擊者可透過 POST /api/auth/login/GITLAB_SELF_HOST 端點發送偽造設定。

raw.desc: Bytebase 0.12.0 before 1.0.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in as any user. The flaw stems from trusting client-supplied GitLab provider configuration in the POST /api/auth/login/GITLAB_SELF_HOST endpoint. Attackers can set instanceUrl to a server they control that returns an active user with a chosen email. Bytebase then issues session tokens for that principal, letting attackers impersonate existing users including the Owner or create new members.

events.title: Brotli 緩衝區溢位漏洞
pts: Google Brotli 1.0.3 至 1.2.0 版本存在緩衝區溢位漏洞，未經驗證的遠端攻擊者可損壞記憶體或執行程式碼。
目前**未遭積極利用**，攻擊者可透過精心設計的 Brotli 壓縮串流發動攻擊。

raw.desc:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the Brotli decoder (c/dec/decode.c) in Google Brotli versions 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 on all platforms allows a remote unauthenticated attacker to corrupt adjacent decoder state memory, disclose sensitive memory contents, cause a denial of service, or potentially execute arbitrary code using a crafted Brotli-compressed stream.





Users need to update any Brotli libraries or binaries between 1.0.3 through 1.2.0 to the latest available version: 1.0.10 or 1.1.1 or 1.2.1.

events.title: GitLab 多項安全性漏洞
pts: 影響 GitLab CE/EE 多個版本，漏洞可導致未經驗證使用者執行程式碼，或使已驗證使用者接管 LDAP 帳戶。

descs: An issue has been discovered in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 7.0 before 18.11.13, 19.0 before 19.0.10, 19.1 before 19.1.9, 19.2 before 19.2.9, 19.3 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, under certain conditions, could have allowed an unauthenticated user to execute arbitrary code on the GitLab server due to integer overflow when compiling a specially crafted regular expression.

GitLab has remediated an issue in GitLab CE/EE affecting all versions from 10.1 before 19.3.6, 19.4 before 19.4.3, and 19.5 before 19.5.1 that, when OmniAuth SAML and LDAP auto-linking were both enabled, an authenticated user could have taken over an existing LDAP-backed account without any interaction from the targeted user, due to improper input sanitization in the LDAP email lookup path used during OmniAuth identity linking.

Missing authorization in the REST and COM administration APIs of Progressive Robot hMailServer 6.0.0 through 6.3.6 allows a remote authenticated user whose credential is confined to named domains to change mail routing and domain configuration beyond those domains on a multi-tenant server. A domain administrator, an account or API key given another role that manages accounts in named domains, or a full-scope API key issued for named domains could create a domain alias for any name (so that other tenants' mail for that name is diverted to an address the attacker controls, or denied), rename a domain to any name the server does not host, set a rule's bind-to-address, send-using-route or script-function action to reach one of the server's own addresses, a configured route's stored credentials or a function of the server's event script, and set the domain's relay host - which delivery then connects to with no address rule - to an address on the server's own network; and over the COM API any account could set the three rule actions on its own rules, where the script-function action runs at delivery. The authorization gate did not refuse these routes to a confined credential and the handlers were not given the caller; over COM the domain-alias save performed no authorization check at all, the domain rename required only a domain administrator, and a rule save required at most that the caller could change the rule's owner.

events.title: Pillow堆疊越界讀取漏洞
pts: 影響 13.0.0 以前在 Windows 上運行的 Pillow，處理 WMF/EMF 圖檔時會引發堆疊越界讀取。
**特製圖檔可導致記憶體洩漏或造成處理程序當機**，目前未遭實際利用。
events.fix: 升級至 Pillow 13.0.0 版本。

raw.desc: Pillow is a Python imaging library. Prior to 13.0.0 on Windows, src/PIL/WmfImagePlugin.py passes unchecked 32-bit WMF or EMF dimensions to the native drawwmf handler in src/display.c. The handler sizes a DIB allocation from 16-bit-truncated bcWidth and bcHeight fields but copies pixel data using the original full dimensions. A crafted wide, short metafile can pass the pixel-count decompression-bomb check and make the Windows-only renderer read beyond the heap buffer, potentially disclosing memory or crashing the process. This issue is fixed in version 13.0.0.

events.title: PHP 記憶體處理安全性漏洞
pts: 影響 PHP 記憶體管理機制，在記憶體不足或全域狀態未正確重置時，可能存取未初始化記憶體。
目前漏洞**未遭積極利用**，相關問題可能引發記憶體損壞或存取錯誤。

descs: PHP uses longjmp() for out-of-memory (OOM) errors to exit the current context and abort handling of the request. Some contexts may not properly account for this scenario and leave request memory in an uninitialized state before performing an allocation. The subsequent request cleanup procedure may read or branch on this memory. Multiple OOM strategies can consistently trigger this condition and lead to remote code execution (RCE).

PHP has various global state that temporarily points into request memory. In some scenarios, global state may not be correctly reset, or may be repopulated after being reset. The global state may then refer to request memory even after it has been freed. Subsequent requests may read or branch on this stale state before it is fully initialized. Multiple strategies can trigger this condition and produce remote code execution (RCE).

events.title: vLLM 多重安全漏洞
pts: 影響 vLLM 0.24.0 至 0.31.0 前版本，可能導致記憶體耗盡及載入動態處理器程式碼。
**目前尚未發現漏洞遭惡意利用**，未經身分驗證的遠端攻擊者可發送特製請求引發資源消耗。

descs: vLLM after 0.24.0 and before 0.31.0 contains a memory exhaustion vulnerability in MOSS-Audio model serving that caches a processor for every distinct request-controlled mm_processor_kwargs value in an unbounded dictionary. Unauthenticated attackers can send distinct or oversized mel_config values to the /tokenize endpoint, which bypasses --api-key, to exhaust host memory and crash the API process.

vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 forwards the request-supplied mm_processor_kwargs.code_revision to Transformers AutoProcessor.from_pretrained, letting clients select which revision of a model's dynamic processor code is imported when trust_remote_code is enabled. An attacker controlling a revision in the served model repository can send a multimodal request to the unauthenticated /tokenize endpoint to execute arbitrary Python in the vLLM API process.

vLLM from 0.7.3 before 0.31.0 contains an uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability that allows remote clients to control multimodal processor parameters by supplying per-request mm_processor_kwargs. Attackers can set large image size, patch count, crop count, or frame count values in Isaac, InternVL, H2OVL, and other processors to exhaust memory and terminate the shared server.

events.title: OpenSSL 漏洞 CVE-2026-113812
pts: Mozilla::CA versions before 20261020 for Perl provide a CA certificate bundle containing a root linked to compromised intermediates. The bun

raw.desc:
Mozilla::CA versions before 20261020 for Perl provide a CA certificate bundle containing a root linked to compromised intermediates.

The bundle includes "emSign ECC Root CA - G3", which provides a trust path for intermediate certificates whose private keys are publicly available.

An attacker able to intercept or redirect client traffic may use these keys to impersonate a TLS server.

LWP, HTTP::Tiny and other clients normally use IO::Socket::SSL, which looks for CA certificates in OpenSSL's default locations before falling back to Mozilla::CA.

Configuration and environment variables can override this selection. Users should check which CA store their client uses. If it uses the system store, check for and install the operating system vendor's updates for this incident.

events.title: Oracle MySQL 產品安全漏洞
pts: 同日公布 12 個漏洞，最高 CVSS 9.3。
Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Client programs). Supported versions that are affected

descs: Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Client programs).  Supported versions that are affected are MySQL Server: 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3, 26.7.0-26.7.1; MySQL Cluster: 8.0.0-8.0.49, 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3 and  26.7.0-26.7.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a hang or frequently repeatable crash (complete DOS) of MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.5 (Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H).

Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Client programs).  Supported versions that are affected are MySQL Server: 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3, 26.7.0-26.7.1; MySQL Cluster: 8.0.0-8.0.49, 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3 and  26.7.0-26.7.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in takeover of MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 8.1 (Confidentiality, Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H).

Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Client programs). Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster. Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Server: Group Replication Plugin).  Supported versions that are affected are MySQL Server: 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3, 26.7.0-26.7.1; MySQL Cluster: 8.0.0-8.0.49, 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3 and  26.7.0-26.7.1. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with access to the physical communication segment attached to the hardware where the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster executes to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in unauthorized ability to cause a hang or frequently repeatable crash (complete DOS) of MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster as well as  unauthorized update, insert or delete access to some of MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.1 (Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:A/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:L/A:H).

Vulnerability in the MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster product of Oracle MySQL (component: Server: Replication).  Supported versions that are affected are MySQL Server: 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3, 26.7.0-26.7.1; MySQL Cluster: 8.0.0-8.0.49, 8.4.0-8.4.12, 9.7.0-9.7.3 and  26.7.0-26.7.1. Difficult to exploit vulnerability allows unauthenticated attacker with network access via multiple protocols to compromise MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized creation, deletion or modification access to critical data or all MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster accessible data and unauthorized ability to cause a hang or frequently repeatable crash (complete DOS) of MySQL Server, MySQL Cluster. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 7.4 (Integrity and Availability impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:H/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:H/A:H).

events.title: Apache Tomcat 多項漏洞
pts: 影響 Apache Tomcat 多個版本，漏洞可導致身份驗證繞過、請求與回應混淆或資料洩漏。
**目前尚未遭利用**；攻擊者可未經授權登入或由具備存取權限的本地使用者利用。

descs:
A missing critical step in authentication vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when the JNDI realm was configured with with a non GSSAPI SASL authentication mechanism allowed attackers to authenticate without providing the correct password.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M1 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.0-M1 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.0.M1 through 9.0.122.



The following versions were EOL at the time the CVE was created but are known to be affected: from 8.5.0 through 8.5.100, from 7.0.0 through 7.0.109. Other unsupported versions may also be affected.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fix the issue.

Incorrect object recycling and re-use vulnerability in Apache Tomcat affecting HTTP/2 processing of asynchronous servlets can trigger request and/or response mix-up between users.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.22 through 11.0.26, from 10.1.55 through 10.1.60, from 9.0.118 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, 10.1.61 or 9.0.123, which fixes the issue.

Buffer under-read vulnerability in Apache Tomcat meant that a large non-blocking write could result in the response body being split between the current request and the next request received on that connection leading most likely to failure of the second request and possibly leakage of data from the first response to the second.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0-M25 through 11.0.26.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.27, which fixes the issue.

Time-of-check time-of-use (TOCTOU) race condition vulnerability in Apache Tomcat when creating unix domain sockets for the APR/Native connector allows an unauthorised local user to access the unix domain socket. The fix for CVE-2026-65183 only addressed the NIO connector. It did not address the same issue in the APR/Native connector.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 9.0.47 through 9.0.122.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 9.0.123, which fixes the issue.

events.title: Linux 核心 多個高風險漏洞
pts: 同日公布 4 個漏洞，最高 CVSS 9.8。
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: smb: client: use finish_no_open() for non-regular inodes An O_CREAT open

descs:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smb: client: use finish_no_open() for non-regular inodes

An O_CREAT open can find an existing symlink or another non-regular
inode. cifs_atomic_open() calls finish_open() on it and attaches a
cifsFileInfo. Symlink inodes have no CIFS release operation, so the
dentry reference held by cifsFileInfo is leaked. FMODE_OPENED also
prevents the VFS from following the symlink.

Track whether cifs_do_create() returned an open server handle. For
non-regular inodes, close the handle if present, remove the pending
open, and call finish_no_open() so the VFS can continue the lookup.
Do not set FMODE_CREATED unless a regular file was opened. For
O_NOFOLLOW with __O_REGULAR, return -ELOOP before the VFS's
-EFTYPE check.

Defer closing a legacy POSIX handle on a non-regular inode until
after inode lookup. This avoids closing it again if lookup fails.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smb: client: fix create context out-of-bounds reads

smb2_parse_contexts() validates the complete create-context area but
does not limit each record to its Next field before dispatching it.  A
malformed chain can therefore expose bytes beyond the current context to
a handler.  The QFid handler also used a full response-structure cast
although it only reads DiskFileId.

The SMB2/SMB3 lease parsers made the same layout assumption: they read
LeaseState and LeaseFlags at canonical offsets rather than at
DataOffset.  A valid non-canonical DataOffset could therefore yield
unrelated in-bounds data, while a short DataLength was still accepted.

Limit each context to its Next value, reject offsets before the context
header, and reject malformed chains.  Bound the name range by the current
context and do not dispatch a known handler when DataLength is zero.  Read
the QFid DiskFileId only when the context data covers that field.  Parse the
lease context from DataOffset and require DataLength to match the v1 or v2
lease_context size used by ksmbd.  A size mismatch skips lease parsing
without failing the open.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: openvswitch: conntrack: fix helper UAF due to extensions realloc

While calling the helpers, a raw pointer to the extensions area is
wired into expectations list:

  -> nf_ct_helper()
   -> helper->help()
    -> nf_ct_expect_related_report()
     -> nf_ct_expect_insert()
      -> hlist_add_head_rcu(&exp->lnode, &master_help->expectations)

In case the connection is not confirmed yet, more extensions can be
added afterwards with *_ext_add() calls reallocating the extension
space and leaving the now invalid pointer in the expectations list
that is later accessed while removing the expectation.

Make sure that helpers are called at the end after all the other
extensions are already added.

Note that the helper rejection now leaves the mark and labels set,
but that's not different from how the NAT was handled before or how
the mark and the labels were handled on confirmation failure.  And
there are no atomicity guarantees provided by the API anyway.

In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

tcp: prevent collapsing skbs across boundary in rtx queue

tcp_write_collapse_fence() sets TCP_SKB_CB(skb)->eor = 1 on
tcp_write_queue_tail(sk) to prevent skbs queued after a switch to
device encryption from being collapsed into earlier skbs.

The fence is a no-op if all earlier data has already been transmitted
when the switch happens: sk->sk_write_queue is empty. The not yet
acknowledged earlier skbs wait in sk->tcp_rtx_queue with eor 0.

On a subsequent retransmit or SACK shift, tcp_retrans_try_collapse() or
tcp_shift_skb_data() can then merge an skb queued after the switch into
one queued before it.

Both users of the fence are affected:

- psp: devices only encrypt skbs with skb->decrypted set. The merged skb
  keeps decrypted = 0 from the earlier skb, so merged data sent after
  psp_sock_assoc_set_tx() is retransmitted in cleartext.

- tls device offload: the merged skb straddles the start marker set in
  tls_set_device_offload(). The software fallback (fill_sg_in() returns
  -EINVAL) and the mlx5, nfp and funeth drivers cannot handle such an
  skb and drop it. Every retransmit rebuilds the same skb, so the
  connection stalls.

Fix this in two places, for defense in depth:

1. Fall back to tcp_rtx_queue_tail(sk) in tcp_write_collapse_fence()
   when tcp_write_queue_tail(sk) is NULL.

2. Check !skb_cmp_decrypted(to, from) in tcp_skb_can_collapse(), as
   tcp_skb_can_collapse_rx() does on receive. skb_shift(), which both
   collapse paths call, already has a DEBUG_NET_WARN_ON_ONCE() for this
   condition.

events.title: MariaDB 授權驗證錯誤漏洞
pts: 影響 MariaDB 10.6.1 至 13.0.2 間多個版本，低權限攻擊者可利用此漏洞設定其他帳號密碼。
**目前未遭利用**，CVSS 評分為 8.8，具備指定帳號權限的低權限攻擊者即可觸發此授權錯誤。

raw.desc: MariaDB server is a community developed fork of MySQL server. From 10.6.1 until 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2, the GRANT PROXY statement treats an IDENTIFIED clause with an empty password as though authentication were not specified, causing it to check the wrong grantor privileges. A low-privileged attacker who can name another account can exploit this authorization error to set that account's password. This issue is fixed in versions 10.6.28, 10.11.19, 11.4.13, 11.8.9, 12.3.3, and 13.0.2.

events.title: Linux 核心 漏洞 CVE-2026-98432
pts: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period tcp_v4_syn_re
events.fix: 原文：This will be addressed in a separate patch.

raw.desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period

tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock() transfers ownership of ireq->ireq_opt to the
child socket (newinet->inet_opt) without copying it.

Another cpu can concurrently process a retransmitted SYN for the same
request socket, and send a SYNACK from tcp_check_req().
tcp_v4_send_synack() and inet_csk_route_req() read ireq->ireq_opt
under rcu_read_lock() only, and ip_build_and_send_pkt() and
ip_options_build() then read opt->optlen twice.

Note that the SYNACK timer itself is not an issue: it holds a
reference on its request socket, and inet_csk_reqsk_queue_drop()
calls timer_delete_sync() before the child can be freed.

Since commit 079096f103fa ("tcp/dccp: install syn_recv requests
into ehash table"), request sockets are processed without holding
the listener lock, so nothing prevents the child socket from being
freed while the SYNACK is still being built. TCP child sockets do
not have SOCK_RCU_FREE, and inet_sock_destruct() frees inet_opt
with a plain kfree(), leading to a use-after-free in
ip_options_build().

A similar issue exists with request socket migration
(net.ipv4.tcp_migrate_req=1, or a BPF_SK_REUSEPORT_SELECT_OR_MIGRATE
program). reqsk_timer_handler() clones the request socket with
inet_reqsk_clone(), so that the old request socket and its clone
share the same ireq_opt, then reqsk_migrate_reset() clears the
pointer in the old one. Another cpu holding a reference on the old
request socket can still be using these options (sending a SYNACK,
or creating a child in tcp_v4_syn_recv_sock()) when the clone is
freed, and tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() also uses a plain kfree().

Readers already use RCU, and other paths replacing inet_opt
(do_ip_setsockopt(), cipso_v4_sock_setattr()...) already use
kfree_rcu(). Use kfree_rcu() in inet_sock_destruct() and
tcp_v4_reqsk_destructor() as well.

IPv6 is not affected by the first issue, because tcp_v6_syn_recv_sock()
duplicates the options. tcp_v6_reqsk_destructor() has the same
migration issue with ipv6_opt, which is only set by CALIPSO. This
will be addressed in a separate patch.

events.title: Linux 核心 漏洞 CVE-2026-98171
pts: In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved: smb: client: fix next_buffer UAF and NextCommand bounds in compound PDUs

raw.desc:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

smb: client: fix next_buffer UAF and NextCommand bounds in compound PDUs

Fix several related bounds checking and pointer lifecycle issues in
receive_encrypted_standard()'s handling of compound encrypted frames:

- Clear next_buffer after assigning it to server->bigbuf. A stale
  next_buffer pointer can lead to a use-after-free on subsequent
  error paths.
- Update pdu_length to the decrypted plaintext size (buf_size). Using
  the pre-decryption length allows NextCommand to point into stale
  ciphertext residue.
- Reject next_cmd values smaller than MID_HEADER_SIZE(server).
- Fix an integer overflow in the upper bound check by verifying
  pdu_length - next_cmd < MID_HEADER_SIZE(server), ensuring the
  trailing slice is large enough for a header.

raw.desc: This is a vulnerability in Bitbucket Data Center, Confluence Data Center, Jira Service Management Data Center, Jira Software Data Center, Bamboo Data Center. Crowd Data Center, Crucible and Fisheye. This Arbitrary File Access vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path; this vulnerability does not allow attackers to enumerate or list directory contents. In some configurations, there may be some sensitive files that make this highly severe. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to access specific files within the web application root directory in affected versions. The vulnerability must be addressed for affected versions of: -- Bitbucket Data Center, introduced in version >= 4.6.0, fix versions: 9.4.26, 10.2.8, 10.5.1 -- Confluence Data Center, introduced in version >= 5.10.0, fix versions 9.2.26, 10.2.19 -- Crowd Data Center, introduced in version >= 2.11.0, fix versions 6.3.7, 7.0.3, 7.1.7, 7.2.4 -- Jira Software Data Center, introduced in version >= 7.1.0, fix versions 9.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Jira Service Management Data Center, introduced in version >= 3.1.0, fix versions 5.12.40, 10.3.26, 11.3.12 -- Bamboo Data Center >= 7.0.1, fix versions 10.2.24, 12.1.12 -- Crucible, fix versions 4.9.15 -- Fisheye, fix version 4.9.15 -- Exploitation requires prior knowledge of the target file's exact name and path. The vulnerability does not include the capability to enumerate or list directory contents.

events.title: FortiMail 路徑穿越漏洞
pts: **未經身分驗證攻擊者可透過特製 HTTP/HTTPS 請求於系統寫入任意檔案**，CVSS 為 9.8，目前未遭利用。

raw.desc: An improper limitation of a pathname to a restricted directory ('path traversal') vulnerability in Fortinet FortiMail 8.0.0 through 8.0.1, FortiMail 7.6.0 through 7.6.6, FortiMail 7.4.0 through 7.4.8, FortiMail 7.2.0 through 7.2.9, FortiMail 7.0 all versions may allow an unauthenticated attacker to write arbitrary files on the underlying system via crafted HTTP or HTTPS requests.
